# CodeMirror 6 bundle

Build input for `crates/dat0-ui/assets/codemirror.js`, which is **committed** and
served out of the binary over the `dat0` custom asset protocol.

## Why the artifact is committed

- CI has no Node, and adding one would put a JS toolchain on the critical path of
  every Rust build.
- `xtask bundle-macos` / `bundle-linux` must stay a pure `cargo build`; a
  `build.rs` shelling out to `npm` would break offline and sandboxed builds.

So: the bundle is regenerated by hand when a CodeMirror dependency moves, and the
regenerated file is reviewed and committed like any other artifact.

## Build

```sh
cd crates/dat0-ui/vendor/codemirror
npm ci          # or `npm install` on first run; versions are exact-pinned
node build.mjs
```

Writes `crates/dat0-ui/assets/codemirror.js` (~413 KiB minified IIFE, target
`safari15` + `chrome100`). Verify with `git diff --stat` that only that file
changed, then commit `package.json`, `package-lock.json` and the bundle together.

**There is no `codemirror.css`.** CodeMirror 6 injects its styles at runtime via
`style-mod`, and dat0's editor theme is generated in `src/index.js` from the
resolved `--d0-*` tokens (see `buildTheme`). esbuild emits no CSS output for this
entry point; if a future dependency introduces a CSS import, add the emitted file
to `assets/` and to `protocol::Embedded`'s include list.

## Contents

`@codemirror/{state,view,commands,lang-sql,autocomplete,search,language}` plus
`@lezer/highlight`. Exact versions live in `package.json`; `package-lock.json` is
committed.

## Public surface

One global, `window.dat0cm`:

| Member | Direction | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `dat0cm.handle(msg)` | Rust → JS | `init` / `set_doc` / `focus` / `theme` |
| `dioxus.send(...)` | JS → Rust | `ready` / `change` / `cursor` / `run` |
| `dat0cm.type(id, text)` | test seam | types text as the user would |
| `dat0cm.complete(id)` | test seam | forces the completion popup open |
| `dat0cm.completions(id)` | test seam | labels currently offered |
| `dat0cm.doc(id)` | test seam | current document text |

`Mod-Enter` is bound inside CodeMirror and surfaces as a `run` message; it never
escapes to the shell's key cascade.

## Licensing

All packages are MIT. The attribution block is in the repository's `NOTICE.md`;
`cargo about` cannot see vendored JS, so that entry is maintained by hand.
